title: FGSS-BO: Feedback-Guided Hypothesis Management for LLM-Based Bayesian Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.21246v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-guided Bayesian optimization (BO) uses past observations to guide search, but proposed directions and their revision can remain implicit. We propose Feedback-Guided Search State (FGSS), a structured hypothesis-management interface connecting language-based guidance to observed evidence, executable parameter interventions, and comparative support updates. An LLM reflector proposes and revises hypotheses; a deterministic curator validates them and maintains identities and test records. The evolving state guides candidate construction and priorities. Instantiated on LLAMBO, FGSS-BO retains its surrogate and default expected improvement selection, with a bounded testing policy. On two retrospective protocol/media tasks with nearest-neighbor response oracles, it attains higher sample mean final best and search AUC than the matched LLAMBO baseline and evaluated non-LLM baselines. Prose-reflection and EI-only controls

translated_title: FGSS-BO：面向基于大语言模型贝叶斯优化的反馈引导假设管理
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）引导的贝叶斯优化（BO）利用过去的观测数据来指导搜索，但所提出的搜索方向及其修正过程往往是隐式的。我们提出了反馈引导搜索状态（FGSS），这是一个结构化的假设管理接口，将基于语言的指导与观测证据、可执行的参数干预以及比较性的支持度更新相连接。一个LLM反思器负责提出并修订假设；一个确定性的管理器对其加以验证，并维护其身份标识和测试记录。不断演化的状态用于指导候选解的构建与优先级排序。该框架在LLAMBO基础上实例化，FGSS-BO保留了其代理模型和默认的期望改进（EI）选择机制，并采用有界测试策略。在两个基于最近邻响应预言机的回顾性协议/媒体任务上，与匹配的LLAMBO基线以及经过评估的非LLM基线相比，该方法取得了更高的样本均值最终最优值和搜索AUC。
tldr: 提出FGSS这一结构化假设管理接口，将LLM的语言指导与观测证据和可执行参数干预相连接，在贝叶斯优化任务中超越了LLAMBO等现有基线方法。
en_tdlr: FGSS-BO introduces a structured hypothesis-management interface (FGSS) that connects LLM-based language guidance with observed evidence and executable parameter interventions, achieving superior Bayesian optimization performance over LLAMBO and non-LLM baselines.
